content.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Executive Assistant in GitLab’s Marketing organization, you’ll support the Vice President (VP) of Growth Marketing and the VP of Product Marketing, reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing. You’ll help both leaders focus on their highest-impact work across teams spanning digital experience, marketing operations, events, community and developer relations, campaigns, product marketing, and launches. Beyond calendar management, you’ll participate in leadership discussions, keep projects and recurring meetings moving, and connect the leaders with their organizations through a monthly launch rhythm. In your first year, you’ll build trusted relationships with both leaders and their teams and establish reliable processes for scheduling, meeting preparation, travel, events, recruiting coordination, and expenses. You’ll anticipate needs one to two weeks ahead and follow commitments through to completion, moving quickly as priorities shift.

What you’ll do

Own high-volume calendars across time zones for both leaders, connecting meeting priorities to quarterly goals and business rhythms. Recommend how to prioritize or delegate requests, and provide inbox triage when requested.

Prepare leadership meetings, all-hands, and the monthly in-person launch review: coordinate agendas, pre-reads, and attendance, keep time, and capture and follow up on action items.

Maintain the leadership project tracker and weekly leadership, monthly goals, and quarterly business reviews. Build work-back plans, follow up with owners, and flag delays, deadlines, and decisions so the right people stay involved and informed.

Coordinate domestic and international travel, including transportation, lodging, security needs, and documentation. Arrange alternatives when plans change, and prepare accurate monthly expense reports with receipts and reconciliation.

Plan team offsites, leadership working sessions, and company kickoffs from start to finish, working with event partners and confirming reservations, deposits, and logistics through completion.

Partner with Recruiting and hiring teams on interviews, candidate communication, and onboarding logistics, and with People, information technology (IT), and Security on team needs. Provide coverage for executive support partners, help onboard new support partners, and take on Marketing special projects. Partner with senior leaders and their teams, helping team leads succeed.

Use artificial intelligence (AI) tools, with Claude as our standard, to streamline research, drafting, meeting summaries, and recurring administrative work. Check outputs for accuracy and context rather than relying on automated summaries alone. Build automations and repeatable workflows to handle high-volume work quickly.

Identify recurring friction in how the teams work, and propose and implement improvements to processes and documentation.

Build warm, proactive relationships across both teams, including timely recognition of milestones and quick, thoughtful gestures such as notes and gifts.

What you’ll bring

Experience supporting two or more VP-level leaders simultaneously at a fast-paced, AI-forward company, adapting to distinct working styles and business priorities.

An organized, reliable approach to balancing priorities, taking ownership within agreed priorities, and communicating progress proactively, moving quickly, and figuring things out independently with limited resources.

Experience managing complex calendars across time zones, using judgment to balance competing requests and checking scheduling details and attendees.

Project management skills, including building work-back plans, following up with owners, and keeping multiple workstreams moving with minimal oversight.

Experience coordinating international travel and team events from start to finish, anticipating dependencies, responding to disruptions, and confirming arrangements through completion.

Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Okta, Navan, Claude, and GitLab, alongside experience with expense reporting, recruiting coordination, and onboarding logistics. Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and a track record of automating recurring work.

Clear, warm, approachable, and proactively personable communication across functions and levels, sound judgment with confidential information, and experience building trusted relationships in a remote, asynchronous environment where documentation and written communication are central. Ability to navigate multi-stakeholder requests with tact, balancing protection of the leaders’ time with support for key teammates.

Flexibility to support meetings across time zones occasionally outside standard hours when needed, with approximately quarterly travel for offsites and events.

Based in the US or Canada with overlap with Pacific Time preferred.

About the team

You’ll join GitLab’s Marketing organization and support two leaders whose teams work closely together on campaigns, launches, and events. You’ll work alongside a globally distributed group of executive support professionals who collaborate asynchronously through clear documentation and shared processes. The focus is dependable support: keeping priorities clear, coordinating global travel and events, and ensuring commitments are completed and communicated as plans change. You’ll be a true member of the team, not just a support function.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range

$95,200—$160,800 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

Flexible Paid Time Off

Team Member Resource Groups

Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Growth and Development Fund

Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.
